persona: Accounts executive handling bank payments moving into corporate treasury
resumeText:
Ananya Iyer | Bengaluru | ananya.iyer@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Senior Accounts Executive - Banking and Payments, Nilgiri Components Pvt Ltd, Bengaluru (2021 - present)
- Prepared the daily cash position across 14 bank accounts and moved funds between accounts to cover payment runs.
- Built a 13-week cash flow forecast in Excel and explained weekly variances to the finance controller.
- Coordinated with four banks on account opening, signatory mandates and renewal of working capital limits.
- Worked with procurement and sales teams to time vendor payments against customer collections.
- Processed import letters of credit and bank guarantees with the bank's trade desk.

EDUCATION
M.Com, Christ University, Bengaluru, 2021

SKILLS
SAP FI, MS Excel, Forex hedging basics
